info.title: Snus Ops Partner Business API
info.summary: Partner catalog, stock availability, quotes and orders
info.description: Example hostnames are placeholders. The API supports server-to-server partner catalog, availability, quote and confirmed COD booking. No reservation/payment/cancel/refund/webhook operations in this version. Server-to-server client authentication is configured at the authorization server; private_key_jwt preferred, client_secret_basic compatibility profile only.

servers.description: Sandbox placeholder; credentials, issuer/audience and data are isolated

post.description: Server pricing, stock check and policy snapshot. Duplicate variant lines are aggregated; final quantity may not exceed 100 per variant. VND only. Shipping rule must exist; pickup fee is zero. Quote creation may be safely repeated but may produce another quote ID. Requires current merchant partner_api write capability; subscription expired or missing entitlement returns 403 merchant_capability_denied.

Location.description: Relative scoped order URL including store_id query parameter.

post.description: Same integration/store quote and fulfillment mode required. Check current grant and pricing/policy version, quote expiry/consumption, order value cap and stock in one transaction. COD booking does not prove payment receipt or delivery. Auth precedes replay; successful replay precedes quote expiry validation. Unique external_order_id across stores of this integration prevents duplicate business orders even with a new idempotency key. No partial order success. All POST attempts, including replay, require current orders:write scope, selected-store grant and merchant write capability. After subscription expiry, use authorized GET order/history to reconcile. HTTP rate quota counts replay attempts; no repeated business effects.

PartnerOAuth.description: Client Credentials at an external AS. URL below is a placeholder; each environment receives its own token URL/audience. No staff JWT or shared Telegram token. Effective scopes are the intersection of access-token scopes and active local grants. Scope enforcement binds permission to the selected store; scopes from different stores must not be unioned. Registry/capability GET readers must not lazy-create business records.

scopes.orders:read: Read orders owned by this integration

writes_enabled.description: Requires both local grants and current merchant partner_api write capability; expired subscription disables quote/book.

collection_status.description: Receipt-evidence status. A posted COD charge alone does not prove money was received.

total.description: Current GET: canonical effective commercial total, including corrections/shipping changes; not cash received/refund disbursed. POST/replay: original booking snapshot.

stock_deducted.description: Historical fact at booking; remains true after cancellation/restock. Not current inventory.

catalog_mode.description: Effective mode for this credential. OAuth clients always receive explicit mode.

catalog_scope.description: Only live variants of live published products eligible to this grant.

inventory_complete.description: False when one or more eligible variants have unsupported inventory or the safe integer quantity total is unavailable.

has_shared_inventory_items.description: Eligible variants share an inventory item. Warn that the per-variant sum is not a count of independent physical units.

available_quantity_sum.description: Sum of available quantity per eligible variant; it is not a deduplicated physical-inventory total.

StoreId.name: store_id
StoreId.description: Must belong to the authenticated integration grant; never defaults to another store.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Signed opaque keyset cursor bound to integration/store/grant/filters; TTL 15 minutes.

Correlation.name: X-Correlation-Id
Correlation.description: Optional client reference only; server always generates a new X-Request-Id.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Scoped by integration/store/API operation, stable across client rotation. Same key/body after timeout. Replay payload retained 30 days; dedup tombstone survives.
